rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a senior military officer or general.

example.english: They became a general at a young age.
example.traditional: 佢年紀輕輕已經做到將軍。
example.jyutping: keoi5 nin4 gei2 hing1 hing1 ji5 ging1 zou6 dou3 zoeng1 gwan1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is widespread, common, or applies to everyone, rather than referring to an overview.

example.english: The general feeling among Hong Kong people is that taking the MTR is convenient.
example.traditional: 香港人普遍都覺得搭港鐵方便。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 pou2 pin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 daap3 gong2 tit3 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when a general account gives only the main points and leaves out minor details.

example.english: We only gave a general introduction to the plan.
example.traditional: 我哋只係粗略咁介紹咗個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 cou1 loek6 gam2 gaai3 siu6 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when something is designed to be usable or applicable across different situations or groups.

example.english: This is a general form that every department can use.
example.traditional: 呢個通用表格所有部門都用得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tung1 jung6 biu2 gaak3 so2 jau5 bou6 mun4 dou1 jung6 dak1

rows.note: Use this for the strategist or tactician behind a military plan, rather than for a formal rank.

example.english: Our general quickly came up with a plan to defeat the enemy.
example.traditional: 我哋隊嘅軍師好快就諗到破敵嘅計。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 ge3 gwan1 si1 hou2 faai3 zau6 nam2 dou2 po3 dik6 ge3 gai3

rows.note: Use this for a renowned or exceptionally capable military commander, emphasizing fame and achievement.

example.english: This famous general led troops for years and won many battles.
example.traditional: 呢位名將帶隊多年，打過好多勝仗。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 ming4 zoeng3 daai3 deoi6 do1 nin4 daa2 gwo3 hou2 do1 sing3 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this for a mixed assortment that does not belong to one specific class.

example.english: The drawer is stuffed with a general assortment of odds and ends.
example.traditional: 個櫃桶入面塞滿咗啲雜七雜八嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: go3 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6 sak1 mun5 zo2 di1 zaap6 cat1 zaap6 baat3 ge3 je5
